findings.finding: The global Bash ERR trap terminates an expected failed staging or PDT attempt before PIPESTATUS is captured, so the preregistered replacement attempt is not executed.
Runner-to-cluster port-forward processes were checked only at startup; a lost tunnel could be recorded as candidate HTTP 000 failures.
The next repetition started as CNI endpoint teardown from the prior repetition was still active because cleanup required only zero active pods.
Rollout success was momentary and did not require a continuous ready, restart-stable interval before warmup and measurement.
The PDT source capture accepted an operational snapshot without proving continuous baseline health or binding that proof to the snapshot.
The active ignored terraform.tfvars used R$1751.10 while the frozen absolute cap is R$1998.268459; targeted cluster plans masked the two persistent budget updates visible in a full plan.

methodological_disposition.required_action: versioned operational amendment, renewed freeze, renewed financial review and renewed researcher approval
